name: web_search
description: Search the web. Auto-selects backend: Tavily (if TAVILY_API_KEY set) → Exa → Brave → SearXNG → DuckDuckGo. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets. SSRF-protected.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-15, default 8).

name: fetch_url
description: Fetch the content of a URL as clean Markdown (via Jina Reader). SSRF-protected — blocks private IPs and cloud metadata endpoints. Optionally uses LLM to extract the relevant portion when 'query' is provided. Truncates large pages intelligently around matching content.

url.description: The full URL to fetch (must be a public http/https URL).

query.description: Optional: what you want to extract from the page. If provided, content is centered around matching sections and optionally summarized by LLM.

max_chars.description: Max characters to return before truncation/summarization (default 8000).

name: bash
description: Run a bash command in the project directory. Blocked: /etc/passwd, ~/.ssh, .env reads, destructive commands (rm -rf /, mkfs, fork bombs). Capped at TOOL_timeout seconds (default 30, max 120).

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is killed. Default 30, max 120.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file. Use for creating new files from scratch — prefer edit_code or patch when modifying existing files. For .sh / .py / .json the new content is syntax-checked before any write. Refuses sensitive system paths and credential directories. Set append=true to add to an existing file.

path.description: Relative path to the file to create or overwrite.

content.description: The full content to write to the file.

append.description: If true, append to the file instead of overwriting. Default: false.

name: search_files
description: Search for a text pattern across project files using grep. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers.

pattern.description: The text or regex pattern to search for.

path.description: Directory or file to search in. Defaults to project root.

file_glob.description: Filename glob to filter files, e.g. '*.sh' or '*.py'. Default: all files.

name: todo
description: Manage a per-session task list. Use to plan and track multi-step work. Actions: add, list, done, delete, clear.

session.description: Session identifier for the todo list. Defaults to 'default'.

name: clarify
description: Send a clarifying question to the user before taking an ambiguous or irreversible action. Stops the current turn and waits for their reply.

question.description: The question to ask the user.

name: process
description: Run shell commands in the background and manage them. Actions: run (start), list (show all), output (get logs), kill (stop).

command.description: The bash command to run in background (required for 'run').

name.description: A label for the process. Used to reference it in output/kill. Auto-generated if not provided.

name: session_search
description: Search past conversation sessions for a topic or keyword. Ranks sessions by relevance, extracts context windows around matches, and uses LLM to summarize the top matching sessions. Perfect for recalling past conversations, decisions, or code from earlier chats.

query.description: The topic, keyword, or phrase to search for across past sessions.

session.description: Specific session ID to search (e.g. 'tg_670967877'). Searches all sessions if omitted.

limit.description: Max number of sessions to return (1-5). Default: 3.

name: memory
description: Manage persistent curated memory across two stores: 'memory' (your own notes, facts, learnings) and 'user' (what you know about the user). These are injected into every session as a frozen snapshot. Use add/replace/remove to maintain them. Do NOT store sensitive data, credentials, or large blobs.

action.description: add: append a new fact. replace: find old_text and swap it. remove: delete entry containing old_text. read: show all entries.

target.description: Which store: 'memory' for agent notes (3000 char limit), 'user' for user profile (2000 char limit). Defaults to 'memory'.

content.description: The new fact/entry to add (required for action=add).

old_text.description: Unique substring of the entry to replace or remove (required for action=replace and action=remove).

name: image_generate
description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Pollinations AI (free, no key required). Returns a URL to the generated image.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate.

name: edit_code
description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. Tolerates minor whitespace/indent drift. Match must be unique unless replace_all=true. Validates syntax for .sh/.py/.json. Returns unified diff. Use patch for multi-file or multi-hunk changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative to project root).

old_string.description: Exact text to find. Multi-line is supported. Must match uniquely or pass replace_all=true.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence. Default false (must be unique).

name: patch
description: Apply a V4A-format patch for multi-file or multi-hunk edits. Two-phase: validates everything in-memory first — if any op fails, nothing is written. Format: *** Begin Patch / *** Update File: path @@ hint @@ -old +new / *** Add File: path / *** End Patch

patch.description: Full patch text in V4A format, including the *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch markers.

name: repo_map
description: File tree + function/class symbols via ripgrep. Use before editing to locate where logic lives. Faster than reading files one by one. Optional: TOOL_query (file filter), TOOL_path (subtree), TOOL_depth (tree depth).

depth.description: Max depth for the tree. Defaults to 3.

name: memory_remember
description: Save an important fact or note to long-term vector memory (LanceDB). Long texts are automatically chunked for precise retrieval. Always include a 'topic' in metadata_json for better search and deduplication. Access timestamps are tracked automatically for pruning.

metadata_json.description: Optional JSON metadata string, e.g. {"topic": "user preferences"}.

name: memory_recall
description: Search long-term vector memory (LanceDB) using semantic similarity. Returns top matches with topic, access count, and relevance score. Chunks from the same topic are deduplicated automatically. Try 2-3 different phrasings if results are empty.

query.description: Search query to find relevant memories.

limit.description: Max number of results to return. Defaults to 3.

name: sys_info
description: Get current system stats: CPU load, memory usage, disk space, uptime.

name: read_error_log
description: Read recent errors from the agent error log to diagnose issues.

name: custom_tool_manager
description: Create, list, or delete custom tools. Use 'create' to build new automation scripts.

name.description: Tool name (used as filename, no spaces).

code.description: The bash script code for the tool.

parameters_json.description: JSON schema of the tool's parameters.

name: skill_manager
description: Manage agent skills. list: show all available skills (core + user). create: make a new skill with a system prompt injected into future turns (optionally enable extra toolsets). bind/unbind: attach a skill to a Telegram topic thread.

prompt.description: System prompt text injected when this skill is active (required for create).

toolsets.description: Space-separated extra toolsets to enable for this skill, e.g. 'inspect media'.

name: skill_install
description: Install an external skill from a git repo in one shot — clones the repo, reads SKILL.md to build the prompt, and writes brain/skills/<name>/. Use this instead of manually cloning + creating files. Requires a public https:// git URL.

skill.description: Short name for the skill (used as directory name and /skill activation key).

repo.description: Public https:// git URL to clone, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo

toolsets.description: Optional space-separated extra toolsets to enable, e.g. 'inspect media'.

name: insights
description: Show token usage statistics and tool usage frequency.

name: browser
description: Control a headless Chromium browser for JS-heavy pages. Use when fetch_url fails or the page requires interaction (login forms, SPAs, infinite scroll). Returns page text and interactive elements.

action.description: navigate: open URL. snapshot: re-read page. click: by CSS selector or visible text. type: fill input. scroll: up or down.

url.description: URL to navigate to (required for navigate)

selector.description: CSS selector or visible text for click/type/scroll

text.description: Text to type (required for type action)

name: recap
description: Quickly summarize the current session or a specific session by reading raw logs directly. Use this instead of session_search when you need a summary of what just happened in the current chat.

session_id.description: Specific session ID (e.g. "tg_670967877"). Auto-detected if omitted.

last_n.description: Number of recent messages to include in the recap. Default: 20.

name: kanban_show
description: Read a task's full state and dependencies.

name: kanban_create
description: Create a new kanban task.

name: kanban_complete
description: Mark your current task done.

name: kanban_block
description: Stop work and ask for human input.

name: ast_edit
description: AST-aware Python editor. Validates syntax before and after every change. Actions: validate, list_symbols, get_symbol, replace_func, add_import, rename. Use instead of edit_code for Python structural changes.

new_body.description: Full replacement function/class source (replace_func). Must be valid Python.

import.description: Import statement to add (add_import). E.g. "import os"

name: last_session
description: Instantly recall recent session summaries. Reads session_recaps.jsonl directly — no embeddings, no latency (~0.1s). Use this when user asks what happened in past sessions. Returns structured summaries with Key Facts, Unresolved Items, and Next Steps for the last N sessions.

n.description: Number of recent sessions to show (default 3).

session.description: Optional: specific session_id to look up.

name: delegate
description: Delegate a task to a sub-agent (Claude Code, Codex, or mini AMA). sync: blocks until done (< 2 min tasks). async: starts in tmux, returns session name — poll with mode=check every 30-60s. kill: stop session. list: show active sessions.

mode.description: sync=blocking (default). async=start in tmux and return immediately. check=poll async session. kill=stop async session. list=show running sessions.

goal.description: Specific task goal. Required for sync/async. E.g. "Refactor auth.py to use JWT. Keep API contract."

context.description: Relevant context: file paths, constraints, existing patterns.

session.description: Tmux session name returned by mode=async. Required for mode=check and mode=kill.

notify_session.description: AMA session_id (e.g. tg_670967877). When set with mode=async, spawns a background watcher that sends Telegram messages directly every 3min and on completion. Always pass this — messages fire immediately without waiting for user input.

notify_msg_id.description: Telegram message_id of the user's request. Used by the watcher to reply-to the original message. Pass the user_msg_id from session context.

backend.description: Agent backend (default: auto). self is sync-only.

name: send_file
description: Send a file from the server directly to the Telegram chat. Use this when the user asks for a file, a log, or a generated asset.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file on disk.

caption.description: Optional text to accompany the file.

chat_id.description: Optional: telegram chat id. Defaults to current chat.
